verdict.rationale: Zoom's docs state per-model language coverage: ten languages on zoom-scribe-multilingual, 26 additional locales on the whisper model, and an English-only Pro model (zoom-scribe-en-pro). However, the evidence gives only counts, not an actual enumerated list. Per-feature language differences are only hinted at, e.g. the profanity filter applies 'when supported by the selected model'. Missing for 10: the concrete enumerated list of language/locale codes, an explicit per-feature language support matrix (diarization, polishing, live vs batch), and independent corroboration.
